_note: Venue registry: (1) AI-reviewer rubric/bar per venue, (2) LLM-use policy for the submission-readiness op. `policy_class` ∈ allowed|disclosure|prohibited. The submission-readiness op generates the required disclosure text and HARD-BLOCKS publish for `prohibited` venues (human sign-off required) — it never helps evade an AI ban. Thresholds are RISK proxies, not proof. New venue / policy change = edit this config.

disclosure_templates.methods: During the preparation of this work the authors used {tool} to {purpose}. All content was reviewed and edited by the authors, who take full responsibility for the accuracy and integrity of the work.
disclosure_templates.acknowledgments: The authors used {tool} to {purpose}. The authors reviewed and edited all resulting text and take full responsibility for the content.
disclosure_templates.declaration: Declaration of generative AI in scientific writing: during the preparation of this work the authors used {tool} to {purpose}. After using this tool the authors reviewed and edited the content as needed and take full responsibility for the content of the publication.
disclosure_templates.body_and_form: This paper's preparation used {tool} to {purpose}; the same is disclosed in the submission form. The authors reviewed and edited all content and take full responsibility for it.

icse.name: icse
icse.full_name: ICSE — Intl. Conference on Software Engineering (Technical/Research main track)
icse.notes: A comparative-reliability claim requires a MEASURED study; a functional-only smoke test does not clear the main-track bar.

aiware.name: aiware
aiware.full_name: AIware — ACM Intl. Conf. on AI Foundation Models and Software Engineering
values: practical relevance to LLM dev workflows
credible evaluation OR a well-specified protocol
aiware.notes: Design/systems contributions for AI dev agents are in scope; a well-motivated design + honest functional validation + a credible protocol is competitive here.

icse-nier.name: icse-nier
icse-nier.full_name: ICSE NIER — New Ideas and Emerging Results (short paper, ~4pp)
icse-nier.notes: A full reliability study is NOT required; values a promising idea + preliminary evidence. Requires cutting to short-paper length.

mlsys.name: mlsys
mlsys.full_name: MLSys — Conference on Machine Learning and Systems
values: measured systems performance (latency / throughput / efficiency / scalability)
mlsys.notes: Expects measured systems performance on real workloads; strong fit for the serving-scheduling-style paper; high empirical bar.

isca.name: isca
isca.full_name: ISCA — International Symposium on Computer Architecture
values: quantitative architecture evaluation (cycle-accurate sim or silicon)
isca.notes: Hardware/architecture; requires quantitative architectural evaluation (simulation or measurement).

neurips.name: neurips
neurips.full_name: NeurIPS — Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems
values: strong empirical results on standard benchmarks
neurips.notes: Modeling contributions need benchmark results + ablations; high empirical bar.

policy.source: NeurIPS LLM policy (disclose if core; no author-side AI detector)

aaai.name: aaai
aaai.full_name: AAAI — AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence
aaai.notes: Prohibits presenting LLM-generated text as the authors' own writing; editing/polishing allowed. Generated text is admissible only as an object of study.

policy.source: AAAI policy: LLM-generated text as one's own is prohibited (polishing OK)

science.name: science
science.notes: Strictest: AI-generated text/figures are not permitted; undisclosed use is misconduct.

policy.source: Science/AAAS editorial policy: no AI-generated text
